summary: Learn CBAM goods screening, emissions calculations, supplier data workflows, and importer coordination. Explore the practical course outline.
lede: CBAM readiness training helps export compliance, sustainability, and supply-chain professionals screen goods and prepare emissions information for importer reporting. Participants practise product-code screening, supplier data mapping, and embedded-emissions calculations through course exercises. They also build traceable evidence records and coordinate data gaps, assumptions, and verification questions with importers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess EU-bound goods, prepare emissions information, or coordinate CBAM reporting across suppliers, producers, and importers.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with export documentation, supply-chain operations, or organizational emissions data is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a representative product, supplier-data, or emissions-reporting example if available; confidential information is not needed.
